topic: Syncing facility data with map inventory
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the process of merging newly installed facilities data with existing map data. It was noted that there is a discrepancy in the number of frames (two found vs. one recorded) for an installed unit.

[p1] explained that the current synchronization method involves [me] running an update script to move frame data into dedicated facilities created by someone else, which already have associated box information. This process requires authorization from that person.

It was decided that updates should be pulled this week so all data can be mapped using the most current information.
decisions: Pull and merge facility data updates this week to ensure mapping uses current information.
action_items: Someone needs to provide authorization for running the synchronization script.
